title: Aura implementation portfolio
description: 03-synthesis/portfolio.json — the machine-readable ledger behind both portfolio views. Verified by verify-portfolio.mjs; a violated invariant fails the run and the portfolio is not published.

generatedOn.description: Supplied via workflow args — scripts cannot generate dates.

sourceRegisterRatified.description: FALSE until the founder ratifies the Stage 0 reconstructed register. A portfolio built on an unratified register is provisional.

explicitlyExcludedChapters.description: C0..C11 chapters deliberately absent from the portfolio. Each needs evidence; silence is an R4 violation.

deferredWg.description: WG items not absorbed into any chapter. Deferral must be a stated decision, never an omission.

unresolvedDisagreements.description: Agent E disagreements that synthesis could not resolve from canonical evidence. These ELEVATE to founder decisions; they may never be dropped.
